title: Replay a historical day
description: Generate 24 hourly predictions from the 2012-11-01 origin. Compare the model, seasonal baseline and observed demand; the displayed day has MAE 31.30.
timestamp_basis: Image filesystem modification time; exact capture event was not retained

title: Read the hourly forecast on mobile
description: Open the same replay in a narrow browser viewport. The chart and controls remain part of the real local application.

title: Judge the entire holdout
description: Inspect paired errors over 3,488 observed targets. Model MAE is 60.29 versus baseline 64.83; the model still loses in two of five months.

title: Locate losses hidden by the mean
description: Open the final-test monthly/hourly slices. Positive model-minus-baseline error means the model did worse. These comparisons use the same observed targets.

title: Request a forecast from code
description: Send POST /api/forecast to the running Python service. The response contains 24 real predictions and their input provenance.

title: Disclose missing custom-history lags
description: Send an explicit empty history array. The API returns HTTP 200, marks custom_history, uses training medians with warnings and leaves actual values null. It does not borrow hidden archive observations.

title: Reject a wrong history type
description: Send history: null. The API returns HTTP 400 because an explicit history must be an array. This differs from the allowed empty-array fallback.
timestamp_basis: Image filesystem modification time; exact capture event was not retained
